domain_restrictions: t is real and satisfies (n-1)/n <= t < 1
k is integer and satisfies 1 <= k <= n
floor is the greatest integer less than or equal to its real input
semantic_sketch_json.normalized_claim: For all integers n with n > 1, for all real numbers t with (n minus 1) divided by n <= t and t < 1, and for all integers k with 1 <= k <= n, the floor of k times t equals k minus 1.

variables.name: n
variables.role: outer quantified parameter; sets the range condition for t and the upper bound for k

variables.name: t
variables.role: parameter controlling the value inside the floor via multiplication with k

variables.name: k
variables.role: inner quantified parameter; argument of floor is k*t and RHS is k-1

statement_nl: For every integer n>1 and every real number t with (n-1)/n <= t < 1, one has floor(k*t) = k-1 for every integer k with 1 <= k <= n.
